finding.problem: Switching to seg = (n + 3) // 4 makes the first three streams ceil(n/4) long, so encode() now raises ValueError for inputs of 262141 bytes or more that succeeded on main, changes the encoded bytes for any length not a multiple of 4 (the last stream can be empty), and adds no tests.
